visual_theme.brand_voice: Calm, refined, physician-specific, consultative, fiduciary, precise, and conservative. Avoid hype, fear, status assumptions, and promises.
rationale: Cold Meta traffic needs education plus an immediate hero form, so AIDA and HeroWithForm balance conversion with trust-building.
Approved repository palette and type contracts override the inaccurate GoDaddy placeholder extraction.
Market sophistication 4 favors a mechanism and accountable relationship rather than outcome claims.
At least half of people imagery must feature African American medical professionals per the task.
visual_exclusions: No coins, currency, market charts, mansions, cars, or handshakes
No broad gold luxury fills or seal motifs
No artificial faces, broken hands, blurred image edges, or baked-in text
Adopt structure, composition, and motion ideas from inspiration references; DO NOT adopt their color palette or fonts — palette and type come from the brand tokens.

color_roles.contrast_verdict: White on #0B1F3A is AAA at 16.52:1; navy on gold is AAA at 7.12:1.

states.default: navy or ivory with underline offset
2px visible border on dark translucent form

component_stylings.name: card
component_stylings.notes: Use editorial ledger rows and asymmetry; avoid equal generic card grids.

component_stylings.name: nav
component_stylings.notes: Logo/wordmark left; phone and form CTA right; no menu links.

component_stylings.name: badge
component_stylings.notes: Small restrained labels, never gold seals.

depth_elevation.elevation_note: Use the surface role for raised cards/panels against background; keep shadows subtle and consistent with the component card spec.

iconography.family: custom SVG plus Lucide where necessary

motion.direction: Restrained scroll reveals and a single continuous gold route that progresses through coordination/process sections.

design_dos: Use the approved Consult Ledger direction already in the repository
Use deep navy #0B1F3A, restrained gold #C8A65A, warm ivory #F6F2E8, white, and mist blue #DCE8F2
Use Cormorant Garamond for editorial display type and Inter for body and utility copy
At least 50% of people imagery must feature African American physicians or medical professionals
Use professional, realistic, non-artificial medical and planning imagery
Use the continuous restrained gold coordination-route motif to make the all-in-one process visible
design_donts: No coins, currency piles, handshakes, market charts, mansions, luxury cars, or gold seal imagery
No generic centered hero followed by three equal icon cards
No obviously artificial faces, damaged hands, blurred edges, or fabricated text in imagery
No broad gold fills or black-and-gold casino styling
No navigation menu or outbound website links
visual_exclusions: No coins, currency, market charts, mansions, cars, or handshakes
No broad gold luxury fills or seal motifs
No artificial faces, broken hands, blurred image edges, or baked-in text
Adopt structure, composition, and motion ideas from inspiration references; DO NOT adopt their color palette or fonts — palette and type come from the brand tokens.

messaging_guardrails.rule: Use neutral calls to action such as Book a consultation, Talk to an advisor, or Get started
State the coordinated relationship accurately: the firm works with outside CPAs, TPAs, estate planners, attorneys, and insurance agents; do not imply it holds all of those credentials
Never reference a visitor's income level, debt, financial hardship, or financial distress
Never frame the service as personalized to the visitor's financial situation
Never guarantee returns, tax savings, lead outcomes, or any specific performance
Never include the $100,000 income-threshold question on the landing-page form
The written-retirement-plan question is context only and must never affect qualification

responsive_behavior.mobile_first_notes: Stack hero copy then complete form; show phone CTA as a full-width styled button. Convert horizontal routes into simple vertical lines. Keep all targets at least 44px and floating CTA form-only.

pages.title: Physician Tax & Retirement Planning | Elite Physician Wealth Planning

sections.name: hero
sections.functional_goal: Earn attention and capture a physician planning lead above the fold.
sections.copy_direction: Lead with the approved tax-first physician positioning and complimentary consultation; support with coordinated retirement planning and fiduciary duty.
sections.imagery: African American physician or medical professional in a credible consultation/planning context.

sections.name: trust-bar
sections.functional_goal: Establish immediate relevance and trust without unsupported statistics.
sections.copy_direction: Use the sourced facts Physician-focused, Coordinated strategy, and Fiduciary duty as identity signals, not numbers.

sections.name: coordination-gap
sections.functional_goal: Show why separate professional conversations need coordination.
sections.copy_direction: Explain that physicians may work separately with a CPA, TPA, attorney, estate planner, insurance professional and advisor; the firm brings the strategy together without claiming to perform every service.
sections.imagery: Practice-owner meeting or documentary planning scene.

sections.name: wealth-blueprint
sections.functional_goal: Make the Elite Physician Wealth Blueprint the memorable mechanism.
sections.copy_direction: Use a concise connected Discover, Assess, Strategize, Implement, Optimize, Review progression grounded in approved site content.
sections.imagery: Desk/stethoscope detail as a supporting texture, not a hero.

sections.name: planning-focus
sections.functional_goal: Clarify the two campaign services and their relationship.
sections.copy_direction: Tax planning is primary; retirement planning is secondary. Explain both conservatively, with no income, hardship, savings, or performance claim.
sections.imagery: Two or more documentary medical-professional images; maintain at least 50% African American representation page-wide.

sections.name: fiduciary-planner
sections.functional_goal: Put an accountable human and verified credentials behind the process.
sections.copy_direction: Feature Michael A. Epps, ChFC®, RICP® and the task-approved fiduciary-duty statement; describe coordination with appropriate outside professionals.
sections.imagery: Real repository portrait of Michael A. Epps.

sections.name: faq
sections.functional_goal: Remove final hesitation using only sourced answers.
sections.copy_direction: Answer what the first consultation covers, what coordination means, how the Blueprint works, and that the written-retirement-plan answer is context-only. Include educational-information disclaimer.

sections.name: form
sections.functional_goal: Convert with the complete task-specified form and phone route.
sections.copy_direction: Repeat the complimentary consultation offer with neutral copy. Ask exactly the four contact fields, tax-planning qualifier, and context-only written-retirement-plan question.
sections.imagery: Subtle approved office texture with strong contrast.

pages.notes: No testimonials, ratings, client counts, AUM, return, tax-savings, income, debt, hardship, or performance claims. Preserve all existing website/review routes; select the landing page by production host.

page_blueprint.internal_linking_notes: Single-page LP with only #form scroll links and tel: phone actions; legal links may open in a new tab if implemented. No links to the main website.

references.why: Client-approved Consult Ledger direction and its navy/ivory/gold coordination-route system.
Current public business-name continuity; content is otherwise a thin placeholder.

build_directives.directive: Implement a separate host-routed ads LP for book.elitephysicianswealthplanning.com without replacing the existing root review chooser or /consult-ledger and /decision-atlas experiences.
Use HeroWithForm with an African American physician/medical-professional image, tax-first headline, complimentary consultation offer, styled phone CTA, and full form above the fold.
Use #0B1F3A navy, #F6F2E8 ivory, #C8A65A restrained gold, #DCE8F2 mist, Cormorant Garamond display and Inter body type.
Build at least eight anchored content sections in the page_blueprint order and end every content section with centered side-by-side form and phone CTAs.
Use exactly firstName, lastName, email, phone, taxPlanningInterest Yes/No, and writtenRetirementPlan Yes/No. Only taxPlanningInterest=Yes qualifies; writtenRetirementPlan never affects qualification.

Install GTM-NH764P5L, Meta Pixel 2343207629431734, universal CTM 572388, source phone 301-259-1636, and lead notifications/routing for info@fiscalvisionfinancial.com. Site ID and key are Flow B placeholders until registration.
Use the real Michael A. Epps portrait and only ChFC® and RICP® credentials; do not add review/testimonial components when proof.json contains none.
Keep at least half of all people imagery African American physicians or medical professionals and reject obvious AI defects or generic finance imagery.
Manually fire MegaTag form_submit and dataLayer form_submission only after successful lead API responses, while blocking invalid, empty, and duplicate submissions.
